```{r loading package}
library(rstan)
```

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
util <- new.env()
source('mcmc_analysis_tools_rstan.R', local=util)
source('mcmc_visualization_tools.R', local=util)
source('confronting_with_real_data.R')
```

```{r cars}
diagnostics <- util$extract_hmc_diagnostics(fit)
util$check_all_hmc_diagnostics(diagnostics)
samples <- util$extract_expectand_vals(fit)
util$check_all_expectand_diagnostics(samples)
```

```{r retro check}
par(mfrow=c(1,1))
util$plot_hist_quantiles(samples,'y_rep',baseline_values = stan_data$y)
```

```{r retro by species}
pred_names <- sapply(1:stan_data$Nf,function(n) paste0('y_rep[',n,']'))
util$plot_conditional_mean_quantiles(samples,pred_names,stan_data$tree_sp,1,7,1,stan_data$y,residual = FALSE,xlab="species",ylab="conditional mean of tree growth (mm)")
```
```{r retro by radius}
util$plot_conditional_mean_quantiles(samples,pred_names,stan_data$ra,2,12,2,stan_data$y,residual=FALSE,xlab="focal radius (*10 cm)",ylab="conditional mean of tree growth (mm)")
```

```{r sigma visualization}
util$plot_expectand_pushforward(samples[["sigma"]], 25,
     display_name=bquote(sigma~"(standard deviation of tree growth)"),
     #baseline=sigma,
     baseline_col=util$c_mid_teal) 
```

```{r y0 visualization}
# util$plot_expectand_pushforward(samples[["y0"]], 25,
#      display_name="y0(baseline growth (mm))",
#      #baseline=y0,
#      baseline_col=util$c_mid_teal) 
on.exit(dev.off())
par(mfrow=c(2,3))
for(i in 1:6){
  util$plot_expectand_pushforward(samples[[paste0('y0[',i,']')]], 20, paste0('y0[',i,'](baseline growth mm)'))
  abline(v = mu[i])
}
```

```{r k visualization}
util$plot_expectand_pushforward(samples[["k"]], 25,
     display_name=bquote(kappa~"(strength of the species in competition)"),
     #baseline=k,
     baseline_col=util$c_mid_teal)
```

```{r r visualization}
# util$plot_expectand_pushforward(samples[["r"]], 25,
#      display_name="r (scaling factor of basel area)",

#      baseline_col=util$c_mid_teal) 
on.exit(dev.off())
par(mfrow=c(2,3))
for(i in 1:6){
  util$plot_expectand_pushforward(samples[[paste0('r[',i,']')]], 20, paste0('r[',i,'](scaling factor of basel area)'))
```

```{r beta visualization}
# util$plot_expectand_pushforward(samples[["beta"]], 25,
#      display_name=bquote(beta~"(Impact of inter-species competition)"),
#      #baseline=beta,
#      baseline_col=util$c_mid_teal)
on.exit(dev.off())
par(mfrow=c(2,3))
for (i in 1:6) {
  util$plot_expectand_pushforward(samples[[paste0("beta[",i,"]")]],20,bquote(beta[.(i)]~"(Impact of Interspecies competition)"))
}
```

```{r hyperparame visualization}
par(mfrow=c(1,1))
util$plot_expectand_pushforward(samples[["log_y0_mu"]],20,display_name = bquote(log_y0_mu),
                                baseline_col = util$c_mid_teal)


util$plot_expectand_pushforward(samples[["log_y0_tau"]],20,display_name = bquote(log_y0_tau),
                                baseline_col = util$c_mid_teal)


util$plot_expectand_pushforward(samples[["log_beta_mu"]],20,display_name = bquote(log_beta_mu),
                                baseline_col = util$c_mid_teal)


util$plot_expectand_pushforward(samples[["log_beta_tau"]],20,display_name = bquote(log_beta_tau),
                                baseline_col = util$c_mid_teal)


util$plot_expectand_pushforward(samples[["logodds_r_mu"]],20,display_name = bquote(logodds_mu),
                                baseline_col = util$c_mid_teal)

util$plot_expectand_pushforward(samples[["logodds_r_tau"]],20,display_name = bquote(logodds_tau),
                                baseline_col = util$c_mid_teal)
```

```{r individual parameters visual}
util$plot_disc_pushforward_quantiles(samples, paste0('y0[',1:6,']'),xlab="y0")
util$plot_disc_pushforward_quantiles(samples, paste0('beta[',1:6,']'),xlab="beta")
util$plot_disc_pushforward_quantiles(samples, paste0('r[',1:6,']'),xlab="r")
util$plot_disc_pushforward_quantiles(samples,"k",xlab="kappa")
util$plot_disc_pushforward_quantiles(samples,"sigma",xlab="sigma")
```
```{r individual parameters altegether}
param_names <- c(
  paste0("y0[", 1:6, "]"),
  paste0("beta[", 1:6, "]"),
  paste0("r[", 1:6, "]"),
  "k",
  "sigma"
)

util$plot_disc_pushforward_quantiles(samples, param_names,xlab="individual parameters")

```
